observations: Industrial flatbed sewing machine head mounted on a wooden table with a clutch motor and foot pedal stand (photo 2).
Nameplate on the machine body reads 'AMRO BROTHER' in photo 1 and photo 0.
Visible surface rust and paint flaking on the head, especially near the handwheel and top casing (photo 0, photo 1).
Stitch-length dial and reverse lever present, consistent with a zigzag industrial machine.
Motor and pedal mechanism visible underneath the table in photo 2, wiring appears exposed/loose.
No serial number, country-of-origin marking, or '20U' model text legible in any photo.

identity.kind: industrial zigzag sewing machine with table and clutch motor

claims.evidence: Nameplate in photo 1 reads 'AMRO BROTHER', not a standard Brother Japan marking, and no '20U' model text or country-of-origin stamp is visible anywhere.

claims.claim: Bought and not used for long
claims.evidence: No usage logs or maintenance history shown; visible rust and paint wear in photo 0 and photo 1 suggest age or storage exposure, which the photos alone cannot date.

claims.claim: Selling because it's not in use
claims.evidence: No corroborating evidence possible from photos.

risks.risk: Machine may not power on or sew cleanly; motor and clutch condition unknown.
risks.proof: A video clip of the machine running with the motor engaged and a test stitch on fabric.

risks.risk: Claim of genuine Japan-made Brother origin is unsupported; nameplate suggests a rebadged or local-assembly unit.
risks.proof: Close-up photo of the full nameplate including serial number and any 'Made in Japan' stamp.

risks.risk: Extent of rust and corrosion on internal gears/handwheel could affect smooth operation.
risks.proof: Close-up photos of the handwheel area and open casing showing internal gear condition.
risks.if_unproven: priced as heavily worn with mechanical risk

risks.risk: Wiring under the table looks exposed/loose, raising electrical safety concerns.
risks.proof: Close-up photo of the motor wiring and plug/switch assembly.

risks.risk: Completeness of accessories (bobbin case, needle, belt, presser foot) not confirmed.
risks.proof: Photo of all included accessories laid out together.

proof_requests: Video of the machine running with motor engaged, stitching a scrap of fabric.
Close-up photo of the full nameplate, including any serial number or country-of-origin marking.
Close-up photos of the handwheel, internal gear area, and belt.
Photo of the motor wiring, plug, and switch assembly.
Photo of included accessories (bobbins, extra needles, foot, belt).
response.reason: The item is clearly an industrial zigzag sewing machine with visible wear and an unverified/likely false 'Original Japan' claim, so it must be priced at worst case as a used, unproven-working, non-verified-origin machine until the seller provides the requested close-ups and a running video.
